mailinfo.Author: Li Lingfeng
mailinfo.Subject: meta: retry ordinary compaction after busy admission

patches.commit_message:
Ordinary compaction requests from Read/Write are discarded when the client
admission gate or the same chunk is busy. If IO stops, completing existing
compactions does not revisit those requests and historical references can
remain until another trigger happens.

Coalesce busy ordinary requests by the existing chunk admission key. When
a compaction releases its slot, reserve it for one eligible pending request
under the same mutex and then dispatch that request. Re-read metadata and
run the existing ordinary batch, retaining the original concurrency gate,
batch selection, object callback and prefix/CAS replacement.

An ordinary admission supersedes older queued requests for that key. A
synchronous max-slices check must not discard a queued ordinary request
when its own threshold is not met. Release a slot only once before forced
recursion so unwinding cannot remove a reservation transferred to a retry.

Discard queued callbacks at session cancellation. This is a process-local
retry of busy admission, not persistent recovery of pre-existing history.
It does not add a scan, timer, configuration option, metadata format, or
automatic retry of an already-admitted operation that fails. Pending memory
is proportional to distinct queued chunk keys, not the number of triggers.

Base: JuiceFS v1.4.1 (0b90c7db5a929ae6adc5faad948d108efd2c99f9)

mailinfo.Author: Li Lingfeng
mailinfo.Subject: meta: test busy compaction retries and slot ownership

patches.commit_message:
Exercise real in-flight compactions held at controlled object-callback
barriers, rather than filling the admission map with artificial entries.
The same tests compile on the unmodified release.

Cover global saturation and same-chunk busy requests on memkv, SQLite and
isolated Redis. Verify retry after successful or failed slot release,
ordinary concurrency preservation, a no-op max-slices check, coalescing,
no redundant object rewrite, existing object-failure policy, and session
cancellation. Test that forced recursion cannot release another attempt's
transferred slot.

An external-package test uses actual vfs.Compact with SQLite and in-memory
object storage. Append new mappings after the first snapshot, request a
busy retry, then verify two ordinary batches, final contents/CRC and source
object deletion without further user IO. Test-only exports expose the
existing entry and raw observations without adding a production API.

Keep all tests separate from the implementation. No module dependency
changes, real TiKV cluster or Ceph installation are required for these tests.

Base: JuiceFS v1.4.1 (0b90c7db5a929ae6adc5faad948d108efd2c99f9)
